cases.question: Chart the goals scored by each team in the 2022 knockout stage.

checks.reason: No successful create_visual call is evidenced (no input/output shown), so the chart cannot be verified. The final answer is primarily text; the rubric requires a successful visual tool call producing a chart of goals per team for the 2022 knockout stage.

attempts.finalSql:
SELECT tm.common_name AS team, COUNT(*) AS goals
FROM world_cup.world_cup.goals g
JOIN world_cup.world_cup.matches m ON m.id = g.match_id
JOIN world_cup.world_cup.tournaments t ON t.id = m.tournament_id
JOIN world_cup.world_cup.teams tm ON tm.id = g.scoring_team_id
WHERE t.tournament_year = 2022
  AND m.stage IN ('quarter_final', 'semi_final', 'final', 'third_place')
GROUP BY tm.common_name
ORDER BY goals DESC, tm.common_name;

sql.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT m.stage
FROM world_cup.world_cup.matches m
JOIN world_cup.world_cup.tournaments t ON t.id = m.tournament_id
WHERE t.tournament_year = 2022
ORDER BY 1;

SELECT m.stage, COUNT(*) AS matches
FROM world_cup.world_cup.matches m
JOIN world_cup.world_cup.tournaments t ON t.id = m.tournament_id
WHERE t.tournament_year = 2022
GROUP BY m.stage
ORDER BY matches DESC, m.stage;

WITH ko_matches AS (
  SELECT m.id, m.home_team_id, m.away_team_id, m.home_goals, m.away_goals
  FROM world_cup.world_cup.matches m
  JOIN world_cup.world_cup.tournaments t ON t.id = m.tournament_id
  WHERE t.tournament_year = 2022
    AND m.stage IN ('quarter_final', 'semi_final', 'final', 'third_place')
),
team_goals AS (
  SELECT home_team_id AS team_id, home_goals AS goals FROM ko_matches
  UNION ALL
  SELECT away_team_id AS team_id, away_goals AS goals FROM ko_matches
)
SELECT tm.common_name AS team,
       SUM(g.goals) AS goals
FROM team_goals g
JOIN world_cup.world_cup.teams tm ON tm.id = g.team_id
GROUP BY tm.common_name
ORDER BY goals DESC, tm.common_name;

SELECT tm.common_name AS team, COUNT(*) AS goals
FROM world_cup.world_cup.goals g
JOIN world_cup.world_cup.matches m ON m.id = g.match_id
JOIN world_cup.world_cup.tournaments t ON t.id = m.tournament_id
JOIN world_cup.world_cup.teams tm ON tm.id = g.scoring_team_id
WHERE t.tournament_year = 2022
  AND m.stage IN ('quarter_final', 'semi_final', 'final', 'third_place')
GROUP BY tm.common_name
ORDER BY goals DESC, tm.common_name;

cases.question: What was the total match attendance for each tournament year?

attempts.finalSql:
SELECT t.tournament_year, m.stage, COUNT(*) AS matches
FROM world_cup.world_cup.matches m
JOIN world_cup.world_cup.tournaments t ON t.id = m.tournament_id
GROUP BY t.tournament_year, m.stage
ORDER BY t.tournament_year, m.stage;

sql.sql:
SELECT
  t.tournament_year,
  SUM(COALESCE(m.attendance, 0)) AS total_attendance,
  COUNT(*) AS matches,
  COUNT(m.attendance) AS matches_with_attendance
FROM world_cup.world_cup.tournaments t
JOIN world_cup.world_cup.matches m
  ON m.tournament_id = t.id
GROUP BY t.tournament_year
ORDER BY t.tournament_year;

SELECT t.tournament_year, m.stage, COUNT(*) AS matches
FROM world_cup.world_cup.matches m
JOIN world_cup.world_cup.tournaments t ON t.id = m.tournament_id
GROUP BY t.tournament_year, m.stage
ORDER BY t.tournament_year, m.stage;
